result.description:
Position: Pastrycook
Type: Full-time
Employer: San Antonio Group Pty Ltd
Location: Kirribilli NSW 2061
Salary: $79,423 - $89,423 p/a
About the Business
San Antonio Group Pty Ltd is a well-established bakery specialising in the production of traditional baked goods and confectionery products. The company prepares a wide range of fresh breads, pastries, cakes, desserts, and specialty items daily using both traditional and modern techniques. Products are supplied directly to customers through its retail outlet in Kirribilli, with a strong emphasis on ingredient sourcing, quality control, food safety compliance, and customer satisfaction. Renowned for its commitment to consistency, innovation in recipes, and high presentation standards, the business values integrity, teamwork, and excellence in every batch. The workplace culture fosters a supportive, hygienic, and collaborative environment where staff take pride in delivering exceptional baked goods to the local community.
About the Position
The Pastrycook plays a vital role in San Antonio Group Pty Ltd’s daily operations, responsible for preparing and producing a diverse range of high-quality pastries, cakes, and baked goods according to established recipes and standards. This position involves hands-on production from ingredient preparation through to finishing and packaging, ensuring all items meet the bakery’s strict quality, freshness, and presentation requirements. The role is essential to maintaining the business’s reputation for excellence and supporting timely supply to retail customers in a fast-paced bakery environment.
Key Responsibilities
Prepare and produce a wide range of pastries, cakes and other baked goods in accordance with San Antonio Group's established recipes, production methods and quality standards.
Measure, weigh and prepare ingredients, ensuring all raw materials meet required quality and freshness standards.
Mix, laminate, shape and proof doughs and pastry products using both manual techniques and commercial bakery equipment.
Prepare a variety of pastry fillings, creams, icings and decorative finishes for baked products.
Monitor proofing, baking processes and oven temperatures to ensure products are baked consistently and meet quality and presentation standards.
Coordinate the production process, including preparing, baking, cooling, finishing and packaging bakery products to meet daily production schedules.
Decorate cakes, pastries and desserts using glazes, creams, icings and other finishing techniques to achieve high presentation standards.
Operate and maintain commercial bakery equipment, including mixers, dough sheeters, moulders and ovens, ensuring safe and efficient operation.
Maintain a clean, hygienic and organised work area by cleaning equipment, utensils, baking trays and production areas in accordance with food safety and workplace health and safety requirements.
Requirements
Australian citizens and permanent residents are encouraged to apply.
Certificate III in Baking or a related field.
Minimum 1 year of relevant experience as a Pastrycook or in a similar role.
Strong technical skills in pastry production, dough handling, laminating, baking techniques, and cake decoration.
Sound knowledge of food safety and hygiene regulations, with the ability to maintain a clean and safe working environment.
Excellent attention to detail, time management skills, and the ability to work efficiently under pressure to meet production schedules.
Good interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to work collaboratively as part of a small team.
Physical fitness and stamina to stand for extended periods and handle manual tasks.
How to Apply
To apply, applicants must submit their resume with a valid email address through this online portal.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

result.description:
Resource Corner Pty Ltd has been built on the principles of integrity, partnership and innovation, traits that have allowed Resource Corner to establish itself as leader in its field since 2006. Resource Corner is global technology enterprise, focused on delivering excellence in complex digital environment, with relentless dedication in IT consulting and services. Resource Corner IT has been working with Banking and Telecom and Federal Department to help them achieve business agility, competitive edge, and growth.

Position Summary:
We are seeking a passionate and detail-oriented Software Tester to join our team in Australia.
Job location:
Head Office is in Norwest Business Park, Norwest NSW 2153, you will be required to work on clients' office (on multiple locations possible), depending on the engagement, whilst remaining a direct employee of Resource Corner

Type of position:
Permanent Ongoing

Minimum Qualification:
Any bachelor’s degree in major computing or equivalent

Experience Range: 5 to 15 years.

Job Description – Software Tester

Responsibilities:

• Researching, consulting, analyzing and evaluating system program needs.
• Identifying technology limitations and deficiencies in existing systems and associated processes, procedures and methods.
• Testing, debugging, diagnosing and correcting errors and faults in an applications programming language within established testing protocols, guidelines and quality standards to ensure programs and applications perform to specification.
• Writing and maintaining program code to meet system requirements, system designs and technical specifications in accordance with quality accredited standards.
• Writing, updating and maintaining technical program, end user documentation and operational procedures.
• Providing advice, guidance and expertise in developing proposals and strategies for software design activities such as financial evaluation and costing for recommending software purchases and upgrades.

Skills Required:

• Relevant tertiary qualification or equivalent experience in IT highly regarded.
• Business orientation with strong IT background.
• 5+ years’ experience in software testing in banking, cards, payments, insurance or financial services environment is desirable.
• Experience in automation testing using selenium, java, tosca, cucumber, cypress or any other automation tool.
• Experience on manual, functional and regression testing is good to have.
• Payments experience with testing on cards, POS & terminal testing is a plus.
• Testing APIs using REST, SOAP UI, Postman etc.
• Experience on ETL, Data warehouse, Big Data testing is advantageous.
• Demonstrated ability to work independently and as part of a team.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills at all levels.


Salary Range: $100k to $150k plus super

Next steps
If you feel this opportunity suits you, or RESOURCE CORNER IT is the type of organization you would like to join, we want to have a conversation with you! Please apply directly with us.

For a complete list of open opportunities with RESOURCE CORNER IT, visit http://www.resourcecornerit.com

This is an exciting opportunity to join in an innovative team in Norwest, NSW 2153 this is a newly created Fulltime position - Monday to Friday from 8.30am to 4.30pm in a friendly, professional working environment which focuses on customer solution strategy.
If you have a passion for leveraging the best from cutting-edge technologies; have an eye for elegance, flexibility and efficiency in design; and are passionate about technology we want to hear from you.

RESOURCE CORNER IT is committed to providing Equal Employment Opportunities. Successful candidates will be required to undergo a background check.

Claro Aged Care & Disability are expanding! This is an expression of interest for upcoming vacancies across our Gippsland area. Whether it be at our established accommodation facilities in Traralgon and Morwell or supporting our Community based clients in the surrounding areas, we want passionate people to join our team! By submitting your application you will become part of a Talent Pool that will get exclusive first access to our new vacancies within your area.    Why Claro?    People lie at the heart of everything we do, and our teams are no different. We have a fantastic team culture and strongly believe in rewarding and empowering our people to do what they do best.    What we offer:    
 
 Flexibility to help with your work/life balance 
 Employee referral bonus to the value of $300 
 Investment in your ongoing learning and development through an internal training platform 
 Retail perks and discounts through WHEREFIT benefits 
 Novated vehicle leasing 
 Electronic rostering platform which makes accepting shifts seamless and ensures timely pay 
 Dedicated email support channels for shift/pay and general queries 
 Celebrating you! Long service thank-you gifts for those who have been with us for 5, 10, 15 and 20+ years 
 
  An opportunity to help people!    Come and join our team! This is an expression of interest for upcoming positions in Residential Disability Support. Come and be a part of our large family of accommodation Support Workers who pride themselves on making a difference in the community. Each day may look a little different but your work will be centered around the following:   
 
 Providing support in everyday daily activities around the home 
 Providing support with hygiene and personal care 
 Assistance, support, and chaperoning activities outside the home environment 
 Assisting with medication compliance which may include the dispensation of prescription medication 
 Meal assistance which may include meal preparation 
 
  What are we looking for?    
 
 At least one year experience as a Disability Support Worker 
 NDIS Clearance - You must already hold a valid NDIS Clearance or be willing to obtain to be considered for this position 
 First Aid (3 yrs), CPR (12 months) 
 National police clearance - or willingness to obtain 
 
   We're looking for people-focused individuals who will be able to brighten our clients' days and make a positive impact on their lives!     Apply directly or get in touch today!    "We pride ourselves on being an equal opportunity employer, committed to supporting an inclusive & diverse workplace. We encourage and welcome applications from Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander peoples, people with disability, people of all ages, cultural identities, gender identities and expressions & LGBTIQA+ people."    If you would like your profile to be discovered by our team of recruiters for future roles, we would love you to join our  Talent Community .     Please  click here  to apply.
